digest.component_or_area: DC outbound comment and description convergence testing
propositions: DC lacks the two convergence test suites (comment and description) that Cloud has, which verify truncated values re-converge to no further changes on a second pass

DC's sanitize_comment binds both comment and description limits to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) and fit_outbound, which is correctly the jira.text.field.character.limit default covering both fields, but this provenance is undocumented in code

A DC comment convergence test driven through compute_outbound_mutations with no explicit sanitizer injection silently falls back to Cloud's sanitizer via select_backend(load_config()), masking the test as passing while proving nothing about DC

A DC description convergence test driven through compute_outbound_mutations with only outbound_mapper injected still triggers the config fallback OR-guard because inbound_mapper and links are also None, resolving the backend to Cloud

DC's comment and description truncation at 32767 plain characters and suffix ' … [truncated by reconciler]' match Cloud's byte-for-byte, making value-based assertions on the comment test vacuous (they pass under either sanitizer), requiring instead an identity or recording proof that DC's injected sanitizer actually executed
